items.heading: Karjalanpiirakka
details: Key ingredients: rye dough, rice porridge, egg butter
Roll rye dough into thin oval shells.
Fill each shell with a creamy rice porridge.
Pleat the edges of the dough over the filling and bake until crisp.
Serve warm topped with a mix of chopped boiled egg and butter.

items.heading: Salmon Soup
details: Key ingredients: salmon, potato, leek, cream, dill
Simmer potato and leek in fish stock until tender.
Add chunks of salmon and poach gently until just cooked.
Stir in cream to enrich the broth.
Finish with a generous scattering of fresh dill.
